from pathlib import Path
p = Path('funcy/calc.py')
s = p.read_text().replace('    Exposes its memory via .memory attribute.', '    Exposes .memory, .invalidate(*args, **kwargs), and .invalidate_all().')
s = s.replace('        wrapper.memory = memory\n', '''        def invalidate(*args, **kwargs):
            key = key_func(*args, **kwargs) if key_func else \\
                  args + tuple(sorted(kwargs.items())) if kwargs else args
            memory.pop(key, None)

        wrapper.invalidate = invalidate
        wrapper.invalidate_all = memory.clear
        wrapper.memory = memory
        wrapper.skip = SkipMemoization
''')
s = s.replace('            result = func(*args, **kwargs)\n            cache[key]', '''            try:
                result = func(*args, **kwargs)
            except SkipMemoization as e:
                return e.args[0] if e.args else None
            cache[key]''')
s = s.replace('        wrapper.invalidate_all = invalidate_all\n', '''        wrapper.invalidate_all = invalidate_all
        wrapper.memory = cache
        wrapper.skip = SkipMemoization
''')
s = s.replace('\n\nif PY2:', '\n\ncache.skip = SkipMemoization\n\n\nif PY2:')
p.write_text(s)
p = Path('funcy/flow.py')
s = p.read_text().replace('    """Reraises errors as other exception."""', '''    """Reraises errors as an exception class, instance, or into(caught_exception)."""''')
s = s.replace('        raise_from(into, e)', '''        is_exception = isinstance(into, BaseException) or \\
                       isinstance(into, type) and issubclass(into, BaseException)
        replacement = into(e) if callable(into) and not is_exception else into
        raise_from(replacement, e)''')
p.write_text(s)
